record_title: A stationary occupancy inequality for variable-length non-overlapping codes
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The uniform weighted inequality is closely connected to an earlier avoidance generating function; the originality claim is limited to the explicit stationary-source formulation and its source-sensitive and average-length consequences. Older variable-length comma-free literature could not all be inspected in full. No independent validation is asserted.
